stackup_formulas.height: GEOMETRIC_LOWER_BOUND = base_skin + tray_floor + pan_depth + lid_inner + lid_outer + mirror + interior_clearance; ENGINEERING_MINIMUM = lower + pan_adhesive + pan_proud + powder_crown + mirror_adhesive + mirror_safety + mechanism_height + parting_gap + mfg_tolerance + warpage; PREMIUM_DESIGN_TARGET = engineering + 2*premium_skin + premium_clearance + decoration_allowance
stackup_formulas.footprint: min = pan_field + internal_bands(on-axis) + wall_adds(on-axis) + 2*margin + 2*tray_wall + 2*case_wall + assembly_clearance + moulding_tolerance + 2*lid_border; external adds reported SEPARATELY

palt_p1_height_result.warning: the geometric lower bound is a mathematical artefact and must never be presented as a production recommendation or a premium thickness

palt_p1_matrix_result.classification: INFEASIBLE_UNDER_ALL_TESTED_MECHANISM_STRATEGIES — the depth axis is short by about 9.3 mm even in the most compact wall-integrated configuration
palt_p1_matrix_result.explicitly_not: NOT proven infeasible under ALL POSSIBLE strategies; six hinge/clasp combinations and both hinge edges were tested, not every conceivable mechanism

recommended_envelope.recommendation: ~116 x 116 x 15 mm near-square, wall-integrated pin hinge + wall-integrated snap clasp on the long edge, adhesive-fixed pans, mirror retained
recommended_envelope.basis: config A2 geometry (109.3 x 111.5 minimum) at the standard 4.0 gap / 5.0 margin, rounded up for premium comfort; keeps the owner's 116 mm width and the 3x3 layout
recommended_envelope.explicitly_not: NOT the smallest option (C1 at 103.5 x 101.3 is smaller but squeezes spacing to 2.0/3.0, which conflicts with MID_SIZE_PREMIUM)
recommended_envelope.status: RECOMMENDATION ONLY — NOT owner-approved, NOT manufacturing-confirmed
